title: Noetherianity and maximal-local regularity of a henselization of a G-ring
statement: Let A be a G-ring and let c present the henselization of (A,I) as the filtered colimit of etale A-algebras trivial modulo I, with its henselian-pair and quotient-isomorphism properties. Then c.pt.right is Noetherian and every maximal ideal m of c.pt.right has a regular map from the localization at m to its adic completion.

proof.text: Apply Tag 0AGV to obtain Noetherianity and the completion comparison, then use Tag 0AGX, Tag 0AH1 and Tag 07QH to identify each completed fibre as a geometrically regular direct factor; this gives regularity at every maximal ideal.
